title: Essential Bengali Verbs
summary: Learn common Bengali dictionary-form verbs for daily actions, movement, communication, technology, work, thought, emotion, and social interaction.

phrases.en: I want to become a doctor.
We go to school in the morning.
He or she comes here every day.
I see the sky through the window.
I listen to music in the morning.
I read a book at night.
He or she writes a letter in Bengali.
I take fruit from the shop.
I want to be your friend!
I want to come with you!
I listen to music in the evening.

phrases.bn: এখান থেকে যেতে কতক্ষণ সময় লাগবে?
phrases.pronunciation: Ekhan theke jete kotokkhon somoy lagbe?
phrases.en: How long will it take to go from here?
Brother, I am going to school.
phrases.context: Talking to or addressing a brother.

phrases.en: The female student reads a book.
The male student reads a book.
Where do you want to go?

phrases.context: General statement about a habit or action.

phrases.bn: আমি আপনার সাথে কথা বলতে চাই।
phrases.pronunciation: Ami Aapnar sathe kotha bolte chai.
phrases.en: I want to talk to you.
I want to tell you something.
She is going to the shop.
He is playing with a ball.
There is a book on the table.
Where do we want to go?
Are you listening to the story?
phrases.context: Asking if someone is paying attention to what is being said.

phrases.en: Everyone is sitting and playing together.

phrases.bn: আমার আপনার কাছে একটা সাহায্য চাই।
phrases.pronunciation: Amar Aapnar kache ekta sahajyo chai.
phrases.en: I need some help from you.
There is no one on the road.

phrases.context: Telling someone to be ready before you.

phrases.en: This book is a written story.

phrases.context: Telling someone to remember something privately.

phrases.en: Had to wake up in the morning

phrases.bn: তোমার সাথে কথা বলতে ভালো লাগে
phrases.pronunciation: Tomar shathe kotha bolte bhalo lage

phrases.bn: এই বইটা অনেক দিন পর দেখলাম।
phrases.pronunciation: Ei boi ta onek din por dekhlam.
phrases.en: I saw this book after many days.

phrases.pronunciation: Ei chhobi ta tulte darun legechhe.
phrases.en: It was amazing to take this picture.

phrases.context: Stating a fact about a family member.

phrases.pronunciation: Amader bari te pakhir basa ache.
phrases.en: There is a bird's nest in our house.

phrases.bn: আমার বাড়ির পাশে একটা নদী আছে।
phrases.pronunciation: Amar barir pashe ekta nodi ache.
phrases.en: There is a river near my house.
There is no friend like me.

notes: These are dictionary forms; Bengali verbs change for tense, person, and politeness.
Many Bengali verbs are compounds built from a noun or adjective plus করা, হওয়া, নেওয়া, or দেওয়া.
